description: Documented SEC series/class to fund ISIN mappings. Each entry must cite independent source records; ticker or name similarity alone is never a mapping. available_at is when these records were captured, not when the mapping first became true.

mappings.method: SEC class-to-ticker record plus BVL ticker-to-ISIN record (two independent documents); copied from sec-nport-aapu-indexed-excerpt.json
